note: Re-quoted 2026-11-25 to the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0; library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz, read offline as owb-am), per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 (Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). This supersedes what the notes below say about the 1962 UBS Bible and about wording borrowed from other Amharic works: every `mined` row is now a verbatim OWB span in its block (exact OWB pieces may be joined with '…'); `self_rendered` rows are allusions and paraphrases left as the translator's prose, each with its `why`. The edition's English epigraphs and dialogue quote the BSB; the Amharic now gives OWB's own words for each (joined with '…' where the English drops words), so a few child-friendly glosses of the first edition give way to OWB's wording (e.g. Gen 37:3's robe is OWB's 'long-sleeved' robe in the epigraph, while the story's prose keeps 'many colours'). Block indexes are per chapter and were re-measured with requote_inventory (the first edition's body rows sat one block late).

Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk whole (ebible mirror gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh); the mirror carries no Old Testament, so Genesis quotations reuse the wording of an already-shipped Amharic work where one quotes the same verse (source_file names it) and are otherwise self_rendered in the 1962 register. The English edition quotes the BSB; as in the other Amharic house books, this edition quotes the Amharic Bible instead.

A `mined` row was re-measured against the finished text: the quoted span is an exact byte substring both of the cited source (1962 NT verse text, or the named corpus file) and of that block. Short spans under 20 characters (Genesis 32:26, 39:2, 16:13, John 1:3) were checked the same way by hand.
Versification: the 1962 Bible numbers John 1:51 as 1:52 and carries the second half of 1 John 3:8 at 3:9; the citations keep the English numbering.
Genesis 50:20 (ch22 epigraph) quotes the whole mined verse, where the English quotes only its first half; Genesis 39:21 (ch19 epigraph) keeps the mined span's opening ግን.
